description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511000
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title determinations.
